ee4c4d223ea39fb346da34f14c5445f5768c7050.ja: # 医療施設（動態）調査の検証（2026-11-17 開始）　確認の状態：機械検証のみ
ee4c4d223ea39fb346da34f14c5445f5768c7050.en: # Verification of the Survey of Medical Institutions (Dynamic) (started 2026-11-17)  Verification status: Machine-verified only

53c0a7b65b86e2b2bdc1cfb15dc3b001067ed8f3.ja:
## 対象と取得
- 厚生労働省 医療施設（動態）調査・病院報告：令和7年（2025）と令和6年（2024）の統計表 Excel、概況 PDF。令和7年の「人口10万対比率等の再計算のお知らせ」（2026-11-10）。取得記録：data/raw/iryosd/MANIFEST.tsv。
- お知らせによると、2026-09-29 の公表時は国勢調査の人口速報集計で率を計算し、2026-11-10 に人口等基本集計で再計算した版に差し替えた。取得したのは差し替え後。
53c0a7b65b86e2b2bdc1cfb15dc3b001067ed8f3.en:
## Scope and acquisition
- Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Survey of Medical Institutions (Dynamic) and Hospital Report: statistical table Excel files and summary PDFs for 2025 and 2024. The notice for 2025, "Recalculation of rates per 100,000 population etc." (`人口10万対比率等の再計算のお知らせ`), dated 2026-11-10. Acquisition record: data/raw/iryosd/MANIFEST.tsv.
- According to the notice, at publication on 2026-09-29 the rates were calculated with the preliminary population counts of the Population Census, and on 2026-11-10 the edition was replaced with one recalculated using the basic tabulation on population etc. The files acquired are those after the replacement.

4971fa9902aca47b54b801c3d4777a0a88717aa4.ja:
## c1801 内部整合・再計算・版間（L1・L5・L3）— 誤りなし
- (a) 統計表10 都道府県（47）の和＝全国（病床の7列×2年）14組、病院の病床＝精神＋感染症＋結核＋療養＋一般 96行：不一致 0。
- (b) 統計表10・9 の人口10万対病床数・施設数を、国勢調査2025年 人口等基本集計の都道府県人口で再計算：624組すべて小数第1位で一致。差し替えが反映されていることを確かめた。
- (c) 統計表1（年次推移）令和7年版と令和6年版の重なる年 176組：差 0。
4971fa9902aca47b54b801c3d4777a0a88717aa4.en:
## c1801 Internal consistency, recalculation, between editions (L1, L5, L3) — no errors
- (a) Statistical Table 10: sum of prefectures (47) = national total (7 bed columns × 2 years), 14 pairs; hospital beds = psychiatric + infectious disease + tuberculosis + long-term care + general, 96 rows: 0 mismatches.
- (b) Beds and facilities per 100,000 population in Statistical Tables 10 and 9 were recalculated using the prefectural populations from the 2025 Population Census basic tabulation on population etc.: all 624 pairs match to the first decimal place. This confirms that the replacement has been reflected.
- (c) Statistical Table 1 (annual trends), 2025 edition and 2024 edition, 176 pairs for overlapping years: difference 0.
